For any single recipient and value, if the callee is the test contract itself (which does not implement transferFrom), then C.transfer must revert and never return true.

property_summary: If every external transferFrom call returns success, transfer returns true and does not revert; if any call reverts, the whole transfer reverts.
For arrays bounded to size 1 with matching value length and a benign callee, transfer returns true and does not revert.

For a single transferFrom call, if the external callee call succeeds then transfer returns true and does not revert; if the callee call fails then transfer reverts, so reverted || result always holds.
For a single transferFrom call whose external callee call succeeds, transfer returns true and does not revert; if the callee call fails, transfer reverts.
When transfer is called with exactly one recipient and one value, it either reverts or returns true; it never returns false.
C.transfer never reverts and returns true when given at least one target and the targets are plain EOA addresses (bytes32 codehash equals keccak256 of empty bytes).
C.transfer returns true without reverting when given exactly one target that is a plain EOA address.
